steps.label: Same tag, re-pushed, points to new bytes

steps.label: 1.4.2 / 1.4 / 1 / a1b2c3d
steps.sub: pin a full semver, float minor/major, tag the git sha

steps.label: Never :latest in a production manifest
steps.sub: pin to a version or a digest instead

code:
docker build -t myapp:1.4.2 .
docker tag myapp:1.4.2 myapp:1.4
docker tag myapp:1.4.2 myapp:1
docker tag myapp:1.4.2 myapp:a1b2c3d
docker push myapp:1.4.2
caption: One build, four tags — each serving a different consumer's update cadence.

code:
az acr login --name myregistry
docker tag myapp:1.4.2 myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.4.2
docker push myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.4.2

aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 \
  | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin \
      123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
caption: Cloud CLIs issue a short-lived token that docker login uses behind the scenes.
